binding_note: Exact per-file SHA values bind reviewed working-tree bytes, including final metadata-cause patch and wording changes; base commit alone does not bind these changes.
limitations: No actual six-volume pilot result is approved or reproduced by this review; forthcoming saved outputs require separate bounded arithmetic review.
Valid affine/header lineage does not establish anatomical registration, skull stripping, N4 quality, visible lesion truth or clinical task eligibility.
TRAIN authorization and actual source/image SHA membership must be supplied by the separately frozen operator manifest; a split string alone does not authenticate provenance.
Masked spatial/presence helpers remain NOT_ADMITTED; support is an explicit proxy, not a clinically qualified brain mask.
Source facts concern the inspected files and selected paper passages only; no full-paper reading, upstream pipeline reproduction or proof of absent unpublished deduplication.
Within-source identity checks and exact/near image heuristics do not establish global cross-source deduplication or independent-patient status.
Low-level geometry helpers assume caller-established input preconditions; the reviewed fail-closed contract is the run_pilot path.
No model execution, training, native qualification, accuracy improvement or change to the fixed plan is approved.
